title: Law to extend beach and pool season and hours
summary: This bill would lengthen the city's beach and outdoor pool season to run from the second Saturday in May through the second Sunday in October, instead of ending the Sunday after Labor Day. It would also extend daily operating hours for beaches and outdoor pools from 10 a.m.-6 p.m. to 8 a.m.-8 p.m., and require indoor pools to be open daily from at least 7 a.m. to 9 p.m. The law would take effect immediately upon passage.
